normalized.result: Yes, that's the right place and structure. Clicking "Edit bookmark" on the card opens one focused form that holds everything together — the gathered title and description, my own personal note, and tags, all editable in one spot. That's exactly how I'd want to manage a bookmark: fix up the auto-filled details and add my own context without hunting through separate screens. This works well for me.
